results.description:
An advanced tool for network diagnostics, LAN scanning, and problem detection.

Network Analyzer can help you diagnose various problems in your wifi network setup, Internet connectivity, and also detect various issues on remote servers thanks to the wide range of tools it provides.

It is equipped with a fast wifi device discovery tool, including all the LAN device's addresses and names, together with the Bonjour/DLNA services they provide. Further, Network Analyzer contains standard diagnostic tools such as ping, traceroute, port scanner, DNS lookup, whois, and Internet speed tester. Finally, it displays various useful information related to your wifi/cell connection.

WIFI LAN SCANNER 
• Detection of all connected network devices (wifi & VPN) 
• IP addresses of all discovered devices 
• NetBIOS, mDNS (Bonjour​), LLMNR, and DNS name where available 
• Pingability test of discovered devices
• IPv6 availability and discovered IPv6 addresses
• Wake on LAN (WOL) including remote WOL 
• Scan of custom IP ranges 
• Filtering and search in the discovered device list

PING & TRACEROUTE 
• Round trip delay including IP address and hostname for every network node 
• Geolocation data including latitude, longitude, country, city, and time zone 
• AS number and network name information 
• Complete trace route visualization on the map 
• Graphical ping statistics updated in real time
• Configurable ICMP/UDP probes for traceroute
• Configurable ping payload size
• Both IPv4 and IPv6 - selectable

PORT SCANNER
• Scanning the most common ports or user-specified port ranges 
• Detection of closed, firewalled, and open ports 
• Description of the known open port services 
• Scan of complete port range or user-editable common ports
• Both IPv4 and IPv6 - selectable

WHOIS 
• Whois of domains, IP addresses and AS numbers 

DNS LOOKUP
• Functionality similar to nslookup or dig 
• Support of A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, HINFO, MX, NS, PTR, SOA, SPF, SRV, SSHFP, TXT records
• Decoding and showing DNSSEC records such as DNSKEY, CDNSKEY, RRSIG, NSEC3PARAM, NSEC, NSEC3, DS, CDS, TLSA 

INTERNET SPEED 
• Test of both download and upload speeds
• Graphical speed test view
• Speed test history 

NETWORK INFORMATION
• Default gateway, external IP (v4 and v6), DNS server, HTTP proxy 
• Wifi network information such as SSID, BSSID, IP address, and subnet mask 
• Cell network information such as network type
• Monitor of wifi, cell and VPN data usage (both sent and received data since the last boot) 

LOCAL SERVICE DISCOVERY
• Bonjour service browser
• UPnP/DLNA service and device browser

MORE
• Full IPv6 support everywhere
• History of all performed tasks with the possibility to star the favorite ones 
• Export by email, AirPrint, and AirDrop for most tools
• Light/dark theme
• Copy/paste support 
• Detailed help
• Regular updates

Network Analyzer Pro is a complete network toolkit that turns your iPhone or iPad into a powerful diagnostic instrument. Whether you are troubleshooting a slow connection, tracking down unknown devices on your network, or exploring how the internet routes your traffic, it puts a professional-grade set of tools right in your pocket - no desktop or extra hardware required.

Discover and identify every device connected to your LAN, watch your traceroute unfold on a world map, measure your real download and upload speeds, and diagnose any host with ping, traceroute, port scanning, DNS lookup, and whois. From curious home users to IT professionals who depend on fast, accurate results every day, Network Analyzer Pro delivers everything you need in one polished app.

LAN scanner:
- Fast and reliable detection of all network devices (Wi-Fi & VPN)
- IP addresses of all discovered devices
- NetBIOS, mDNS (Bonjour), LLMNR, DNS, and SNMP name where available
- Reachability (ping) test of discovered devices
- IPv6 availability and discovered IPv6 addresses
- Custom device names, scan history, and favorites
- Device quick actions: open the web interface, browse the device's Bonjour and UPnP services, or wake it up
- Wake on LAN (WOL) including remote WOL
- Scan of custom IP ranges
- Filtering and search in the discovered device list

Ping & traceroute:
- Round-trip delay including IP address and hostname for every network node
- Selectable ICMP, UDP, and TCP ping
- Configurable probe delay, payload size, TCP port, and don't-fragment flag
- Audible ping
- Geolocation data including latitude, longitude, country, city, and time zone
- AS number and network name information
- Complete traceroute visualization on the map
- Graphical ping statistics updated in real time
- Configurable ICMP/UDP probes and probe delays for traceroute
- Both IPv4 and IPv6 - selectable

Port scanner:
- Scan common ports, custom port ranges, or the complete port range
- Detection of closed, firewalled, and open ports
- Description of the known open port services
- User-editable common port list
- Adjustable scan rate
- Both IPv4 and IPv6 - selectable

Whois:
- Look up domains, IP addresses, and AS numbers
- Support for both classic whois and the modern RDAP protocol
- Custom whois and RDAP servers

DNS lookup:
- Functionality similar to nslookup or dig
- Query all record types at once or one specific type
- Support for A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, HINFO, LOC, MX, NAPTR, NS, PTR, SOA, SPF, SRV, SSHFP, TXT records
- Decoding and showing DNSSEC records such as DNSKEY, CDNSKEY, RRSIG, NSEC3PARAM, NSEC, NSEC3, DS, CDS, TLSA
- Custom DNS server and port
- Options to disable recursion and show all response sections

Internet speed:
- Test of both download and upload speeds
- Graphical speed test view
- Speed test history

Network information:
- Default gateway, external IP (v4 and v6), DNS server, HTTP proxy
- External IP hostname, AS number, and AS name
- Wi-Fi network information such as SSID, BSSID, router vendor, security type, IP address, and subnet mask
- VPN, USB Ethernet, and personal hotspot connection details
- Cell network information such as network type, with dual SIM support
- Monitor of Wi-Fi, cell, and VPN data usage (both sent and received data since the last boot)

Local service discovery:
- Bonjour service browser
- UPnP/DLNA service and device browser

Siri, Shortcuts, and controls:
- Siri, Spotlight, and Shortcuts app support for every tool
- Control Center, Lock Screen, and Action button controls
- Share extension: query any website straight from Safari's share sheet
- Home screen quick actions

More:
- Light and dark theme
- Full IPv6 support everywhere
- History of all performed tasks with the ability to star favorites
- Export by email, AirPrint, and AirDrop for most tools
- Copy/paste support
- Detailed help
- Regular updates

- add control center actions
- add Safari extension allowing to launch the app and query the visited page
- various speed tester reliability fixes
- add Settings shortcut to the About page
- lots of cleanups, bug fixes and internal modernization of the app
